Node has exactly the shape documented by formula-parser.","collectDependencies(ast: {type: 'expression', expression: Node}): string[] — returns each referenced cell address exactly once in first-occurrence order.","normalizeRange(start: string, end: string): string[] — returns normalized addresses in row-major order;
